# Tripo H3.1 Multiview to 3D

> Generate 3D models from multiple view images using Tripo H3.1.


## Overview

- **Endpoint**: `https://fal.run/tripo3d/h3.1/multiview-to-3d`
- **Model ID**: `tripo3d/h3.1/multiview-to-3d`
- **Category**: image-to-3d
- **Kind**: inference
**Tags**: 3d, multiview-to-3d, 3d-generation, tripo



## Pricing

Your request will cost $0.20 (without textures), $0.30 (with standard textures), or $0.40 (with HD textures), plus an additional $0.20 for detailed geometry and $0.05 for quad mesh if selected.

For more details, see [fal.ai pricing](https://fal.ai/pricing).

## API Information

This model can be used via our HTTP API or more conveniently via our client libraries.
See the input and output schema below, as well as the usage examples.


### Input Schema

The API accepts the following input parameters:


- **`image_urls`** (`list<string>`, _required_):
  2 to 4 image URLs of the same object from different angles. Order: [front, left, back, right]. Front view is required.
  - Array of string
  - Examples: ["https://v3b.fal.media/files/b/zebra/3osHJDI8IZ2wl6sGtEUeB_image.png","https://v3b.fal.media/files/b/zebra/3osHJDI8IZ2wl6sGtEUeB_image.png"]

- **`face_limit`** (`integer`, _optional_):
  Target number of faces for the generated mesh. If not set, the model adaptively determines the count.
  - Range: `1000` to `2000000`
